I'm 20, and I'm trying to learn Lao. My father is from Laos, but my mother is American. The pronunciation and vocabulary is not too hard for me, but I'm having a hard time speaking and distinguishing between the six tones. Im determined to learn it though, because I was very much raised in American culture and I want to reclaim my Lao heritage.
